    input = sys.stdin.read().split()
    index = 0
    t = int(input[index])
    index += 1
    results = []
    for _ in range(t):
        n = int(input[index])
        index += 1
        weights = list(map(int, input[index:index+n]))
        index += n
        weights.sort()
        max_score = 0
        if n == 3:
            max_score = abs(weights[0] - weights[1]) + abs(weights[1] - weights[2])
        else:
            max_score = max(max_score, abs(weights[-1] - weights[0]) + abs(weights[-1] - weights[1]))
            max_score = max(max_score, abs(weights[-1] - weights[-2]) + abs(weights[-2] - weights[0]))
            max_score = max(max_score, abs(weights[-1] - 2*weights[0] + weights[1]))
            max_score = max(max_score, abs(weights[-2] - 2*weights[0] + weights[1]))
            if n > 3:
                max_score = max(max_score, abs(weights[-1] - weights[2]) + abs(weights[-2] - weights[1]))
                max_score = max(max_score, abs(weights[-1] - weights[-3]) + abs(weights[-2] - weights[-3]))
        results.append(max_score)
    print("\n".join(map(str, results)))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
